core_meaning.primary_meaning: Marzia is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pleasing, content”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Marzia corresponds to the Arabic form مرضية (Arabic root ر ض ي (r-ḍ-y); مَرْضِيَّة (Marḍiyya)). Its core sense is marzia; pleasing (feminine). Marzia is Arabic مَرْضِيَّة (Marḍiyya) 'pleasing, content' (feminine), from the root ر ض ي (r-ḍ-y). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave مَرْزِيَة (a different form); the correct form is مَرْضِيَّة. The source gloss 'Bitter or Wished-for Child' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as marzi, marzieh and marziya.
